profile.headline: UX/UI Designer
profile.summary:
I am a developing UX/UI Designer and Developer with a goal of designing and developing applications that are User-Centered, responsive, elegant, and offer excellent digital experiences. 

I have skills in HTML, CSS, Javascript, Bootstrap, React and React Native, Abobe Suite, and Microsoft Office, and a strong desire to continue expanding my knowledge.

Currently improving skills and planning to learn Git Hub, Node, Mongo DB, Python, and C#.
